reason: A conversation-data migration plugin that previews and imports or exports records between DSH and several coding-agent platforms through CLI, UI, slash commands, and an API.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 与 Codex、Claude Code、Pi、Reasonix、OpenCode 之间预览并迁移对话记录，支持命令行、界面和插件 API。
summaries.en: Preview and migrate conversation records between DeepSeek Harness and Codex, Claude Code, Pi, Reasonix, or OpenCode through a CLI, UI, and plugin API.

capabilities: Reads conversation records from configured local source paths and DSH session storage
Transforms provider-specific conversation data into a provider-neutral model
Writes imported conversations to DSH storage and exports to configured destination formats
Provides CLI, settings UI, slash command, and plugin API interfaces
Supports preview operations and applies changes only when explicitly requested
